description.zh:
返回的最大数。取值范围：1~100
默认值：50。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 100.
Default value: 50.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用无需配置。
description.en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request.
The list of task IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

description.zh:
任务状态。取值范围：
- Finished：已完成。
- Processing：运行中。
- Failed：失败。

默认值：无。

> 只支持查询状态为Finished、Processing和Failed的任务，填入其他取值将不会生效。
description.en:
The task status. Valid values:
- Finished: The task is completed.
- Processing: The task is running.
- Failed: The task has failed.

Default value: none.

> Only tasks in the Finished, Processing, or Failed state can be queried. Other values do not take effect.

description.zh:
任务操作的接口名称。取值范围：
- Shell：运行shell命令。
- InstallApplication：安装应用。
- UninstallApplication：卸载应用。
- SendFile：上传文件。
- ImportImage：导入镜像。
description.en:
The name of the API operation for the task. Valid values:
- Shell: runs a shell command.
- InstallApplication: installs an application.
- UninstallApplication: uninstalls an application.
- SendFile: uploads a file.
- ImportImage: imports an image.
